scope: Publicly licensed construction drawings; verified named development manifests and human expert annotations for AfterQuery task curation.
privacy: No private dataset drawing imported; no client addresses, system answers, cookies or secrets included. Expert methods retained only for selected public drawings.

split_policy.disclosure: Holdout scenarios share drawings with train scenarios. All scenarios were inspected during curation; holdout means reserved from policy/prompt tuning, not a blind untouched test and not unseen-building generalization.

scan_policy.operations: grayscale; Gaussian blur radius0.55; contrast0.72; seeded additive Gaussian noise sd2.0; JPEG quality68; PNG output
scan_policy.geometry: No resampling after initial rasterization; no crop, rotation or skew. Clean and synthetic scan dimensions identical, evidence coordinates unchanged.
scan_policy.quality_note: Synthetic scan stress test, not a claim of real scan acquisition or full scan realism.
